status_legend.declined: deliberate non-coverage tied to the capability it declines; requires a reason (rail-checked).

notes.ground_truth: Grounded in docs/installed_externals_manifest.json (26 installed externals: 14 superpowers + 11 mattpocock + 1 vercel-labs), NOT DESIGN_SPEC Section F's expected sets. See the manifest's reconciliation block for the spec delta.
notes.spec_delta: DESIGN_SPEC Section F expected '21 Pocock v1.1.0' capabilities whose names (to-tickets/diagnosing-bugs/writing-great-skills/code-review/triage/implement/prototype/research/codebase-design/domain-modeling/handoff/setup/to-spec/wayfinder/ask-matt/teach/grilling/...) do not match the installed mattpocock/skills folders. Where a Section-F capability maps cleanly to an installed folder it is preserved (to-tickets->to-issues, diagnosing-bugs->diagnose, writing-great-skills->write-a-skill, grilling->grill-me/grill-with-docs, code-review->reviewer's Fowler pass). Section-F capabilities with no installed folder (wayfinder/ask-matt/teach/handoff/setup/research/prototype/codebase-design/domain-modeling/implement/triage/to-spec) are NOT installed externals and are therefore not ledger rows; their intended homes remain as recorded in Section F for reference.
